backend/main.mo: Motoko backend with authorization mixin, type definitions, and CRUD logic for company settings, user profiles, clients, products, quotations, and ledger entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, associated files, components, and test IDs for UI updates and profile-flow removal.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten mapping of frontend source files to short summaries describing their UI roles and styling characteristics.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining OKLCH-derived CSS variables for light/dark modes and global background, text, and border utilities.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point setting up root container and loading the Vite React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component that manages Internet Identity authentication and conditionally renders the login page or main app shell.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Authenticated dashboard shell providing navigation, header with branding and user info, and dialogs for user and company management.
frontend/src/components/billing/InvoiceP: Dialog that loads client and company data, shows an invoice print preview, and provides print and close actions.
Renders a printable invoice layout with company details, client info, and quotation item data.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientDe: Dialog displaying client info and ledger entries with totals and export-to-PDF/CSV actions.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientFo: Form dialog for creating or editing a client with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/clients/LedgerSu: Simple summary card showing total debit, credit, and current balance values.
frontend/src/components/company/CompanyS: Dialog for editing company settings including text fields and optional logo upload.
frontend/src/components/dialogs/ConfirmD: Reusable confirmation dialog with customizable text and loading state.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Produc: Dialog form for creating or editing products, managing product fields, validation, and submitting mutations.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Displays detailed product specifications, description, details, and pricing in a read-only dialog.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Empty placeholder file intended for a profile setup dialog component.
frontend/src/components/quotations/Quota: Shows full quotation details including client info, product specs, pricing, and provides access to print preview.
Form dialog to create new quotations, auto-filling product details and validating required inputs before submission.
Provides a print preview for a quotation, rendering a print-friendly view and offering print and close actions.
Renders the printable quotation layout including company details, client info, and product specifications.
frontend/src/components/UserManagementDi: Admin dialog allowing assignment of user roles via principal ID with form validation and success/error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/logout control, and an auth client via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, company settings, clients, and admin-related actions using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based theme variables, light/dark modes, and shared UI component styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, setting up the QueryClient and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/accounts/AccountsPage: Displays and edits company accounting settings with admin-only update access and validation.
frontend/src/pages/billing/BillingPage.t: Displays approved quotations and allows generating invoices with a print preview dialog.
frontend/src/pages/clients/ClientsPage.t: Lists clients and provides actions to add, edit, view, and delete client records.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/InventoryPa: Shows product inventory and supports adding, editing, and deleting products.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders a login screen that triggers Internet Identity authentication and displays login states or errors.
frontend/src/pages/products/ProductsPage: Displays a catalog of products with details and stock levels, with a dialog for viewing product info.
frontend/src/pages/quotations/Quotations: Manages quotations, including creation, viewing, and toggling approval for admins.
frontend/src/utils/ledgerExport.ts: Exports client ledger data to printable PDF or downloadable CSV formats.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and clear parameters from the URL or session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, container settings, shadows, and plugins for typography, animation, and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, listing existing features, pending requests, metadata, and versioning for the profile removal and UI refresh project.
